scope.native: STAGED_EMITTED_PUBLIC_ENTRY; genuine isolated NodeNext emitted dist/index.js
notQualified: general rigid rotation accuracy or whole-roadmap completion

referenceCountBoundary.explanation: Math/audits complete; counts before committing finish response; final packet gives durable returned count1710

conservationGates.angularMomentumAndEnergy: e+e*max(1,abs(initial),abs(after)), e=1e-12; saved exact bound at each displayed maximum retained
conservationGates.COMAndLinear: absolute component<=1e-12 in m and kg m/s respectively
conservationGates.zeroSigns: Fraction does not establish computed-zero signs; raw state words are retained separately.

trajectoryGate: Worst distance to saved ideal interval endpoints <=1e-11+1e-12*abs(reference) per omega/R/q component. Compact saved audit keeps per-quantity maximum, not the maximizing component; ratioToAbsoluteGateFloor is a conservative error/1e-11 diagnostic, not an invented exact component gate ratio.

analyticBank.crossPrecision: Original reference PASS required120 enclosed by80; no new reference evaluation performed by reporter.

source.wordScope: Every {$f64le} numeric field in complete stateRaw, including cursor/options identity and pair counters; ordinary outer frame stepIndex is not counted.

native.wordScope: Every {$f64le} numeric field in complete stateRaw, including cursor/options identity and pair counters; ordinary outer frame stepIndex is not counted.

rawParity.driverStatus: PASS_ALL_NON_PROVIDER_FIELDS; graph-specific providerDigest exact and preserved
rawParity.comparisonScope: All public non-provider fields/number words exact; each distinct providerDigest preserved and checked against its own actual manifest. Reporter counts saved words without re-running physics.

timing.gateWaitAuthority: Parent observed heavy-gate transcript; outside the guard timing boundary
timing.interpretation: Whole finite campaign including build/reference/I/O; not a solver/performance benchmark.

resources.ownedChargeScope: source-derived layout allowance for retained plain DATA plus2MiB transient allowance; not measured heap/RSS
resources.interpretation: Actual artifact bytes and source-derived owned layout allowances; not measured process heap/RSS.

reporterScope.operation: Read/hash/count and exact Fraction comparisons of saved scalar residual/width data only. No physical formulas, new geometry/ODE/linear solve, candidate/reference import, module evaluation, build, fixture conversion or World call.
reporterScope.rawWhitespace: Original bytes hashed as-is; no trim/normalization/rewrite. Parent owns any whitespace-check exception and archive metadata.
